<!--
Per CONTRIBUTING.md, methodology changes use ADRIAN's own Request Contract format.
Fill in all six sections. If any section is missing, the proposal will be sent
back for revision.
-->

## 1. Summary

<!-- One sentence or short paragraph: what should change for users of ADRIAN, in user-facing language. -->

## 2. Description

<!-- The fuller narrative: what's happening today, what should happen, context. -->

## 3. User Impact

<!-- Who is affected by this change and how much (1-5 with one line of rationale). -->

## 4. Business Context

<!-- Why this matters to the framework now (1-5 with one line of rationale). -->

## 5. Boundaries

### In scope
<!-- What this proposal changes -->
-

### Out of scope
<!-- What this proposal explicitly does NOT change -->
-

### Deferred
<!-- Related changes that should wait for separate proposals -->
-

## 6. Constraints

<!-- What must remain true regardless of this change.
     E.g., backward compatibility with v0.1, doc-only change, etc. -->
-

## 7. Decisions

<!-- Prior ADRIAN decisions this proposal respects or revisits.
     Reference specific files or sections. -->
-

## 8. Acceptance Criteria

<!-- How we'll know the change is well-specified.
     Use Gherkin-style scenarios where appropriate. -->

### Positive

### Negative / Edge

## 9. Verification

<!-- How we'll know the change worked once merged.
     Could be: docs are clearer, contributors adopt the pattern, etc. -->
-

## Additional context

<!-- Anything else: links to prior discussion, your team's experience with the issue, etc. -->
